Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Securitatea computerelor și a rețelelor
REVELSI is a global cybersecurity, AI, software, and infrastructure services organization. We work with worldwide enterprises to design, build, secure, and operate the systems their business depends on. Our top priority is safeguarding the fast-evolving global infrastructures and technologies. We integrate cybersecurity into infrastructure development and operational processes, alongside software development, to proactively stay at the leading edge of industry
 advancements.
 REVELSI TEAM 
 At REVELSI, we combine deep technical expertise with a Silicon Valley-inspired mindset: agile, innovative, and collaborative. We’re a collaborative team that values performance and a positive work environment. We are committed to delivering high-quality results, supporting each other, and fostering a professional and friendly atmosphere. We’re looking for a team player with specialized skills and ready to make an impact alongside experts in cybersecurity, network design, architecture, AI & software development, and IT management. You’ll collaborate with experienced IT (Security) professionals, expand your skills, and enjoy the journey in a team that embraces challenges with energy and enthusiasm.
 YOUR DAY-TO-DAY 
 Foundation 
Design the agent data model to extend the Power BI correlation layer planned for the human identity governance program. That layer is not built yet, so work with the program team so both share one model and add agent measures to the existing CISO dashboard.
Bring in agent and shadow AI signals from Zenity, Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Endpoint, Zscaler, and Entra.
Match the same agent across tools to one record keyed on its Entra identity, and report agents that were discovered but never registered.
Set baselines from day 1: agents by owner and agents with no owner, so the trend shows the service's effect.
Model Zenity findings and ServiceNow tickets with the Engineer, and flag findings that have no ticket.
Produce data quality reports on duplicates, stale identities, and missing owners.
 Governance 
Build the unified audit trail: add agent activity logs (Entra sign-ins, application logs, MCP connector activity) and link each action to the agent's owner, entitlement, and approval.
Report entitlement drift by comparing permissions held in Entra with permissions approved in ServiceNow, including delegates that hold wider access than the agent that called them.
Flag agents reaching MNPI-scoped systems or crossing information barriers.
Report compliance with the firm's agent policies by owner and policy, once the finding workflow is live.
Report lifecycle events and certification campaigns: agents whose owner left or moved, completion rates, access revoked, and overdue reviewers.
Report MCP catalog activity: intake requests, approvals, exceptions, and connectors in use outside the catalog.
Publish to the CISO dashboard with row-level security by business unit, released through the client's change process. 
 Run state 
Monitor refreshes and fix breaks when Zenity, Entra, or ServiceNow change their schemas or APIs.
Produce the lists that trigger certification campaigns and new-agent entitlement reviews.
Prepare the monthly governance report and the executive briefing pack with the Service Lead.
Answer audit trail queries during incidents and examinations.
Keep the model tool-neutral, so a vendor change touches one connector rather than every report.
 YOUR PROFILE 
4 or more years building production Power BI solutions, including data modelling, DAX, and Power Query.
Strong SQL and experience designing star-schema models that keep history over time.
Experience integrating data from SaaS platforms through REST APIs.
Hands-on experience with row-level security, workspace governance, and deployment pipelines in the Power BI service.
A record of building executive-level reporting with trend and compliance measures.
Clear written and spoken English, and comfort presenting work to client stakeholders.
Ability to work with confidential client data in a regulated environment and pass client background screening.
Experience querying large log datasets with KQL in Log Analytics, Microsoft Sentinel, or Microsoft Fabric – nice to have.
Experience with Microsoft Graph and Entra data: app registrations, service principals, owners, and permissions – nice to have.
Experience reporting on ServiceNow data, especially requests, approvals, and remediation tickets – nice to have.
Background in identity governance, access certification, or security reporting – nice to have.
Familiarity with AI security tools such as Zenity, or with AI agent platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio – nice to have.
Experience building paginated reports for audit or regulatory use – nice to have.
Financial services experience – nice to have.
Microsoft PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) certification – nice to have.
Willing to work from Monday to Friday between 12:00 and 21:00 with 1 hour lunch break, in a hybrid system (4 days from our office).
 WE VALUE OUR EMPLOYEES: 
 At REVELSI, we create an environment that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance:
Private healthcare & medical insurance
Private dental services
Meal vouchers
Referral bonus program
Learning & development opportunities
Team buildings & events
Pizza day and free drinks at the office
Seasonal gifts (Christmas / Easter)
21 days PTO, increasing up to 25 based on seniority
 Ready to Join Us?
 Click “ Apply ” and let’s get started!
 Every day is an opportunity to grow and go beyond our limits! We embrace challenges and succeed together as a team—because great things happen when we collaborate.
 REVELSI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
